Machine Learning Engineer for Document Q&A System

Experience level: Intermediate | Pricing type: Hourly | Duration: 1 to 3 months | Hours per week: 20 hrs/week

Summary

We need an ML engineer to build a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline over a set of internal PDF documents. Must know Python and Hugging Face Transformers. Experience with vector databases is a plus.

Skills: Python, RAG, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP

Computer Vision Engineer - Product Image Classifier

Experience level: Entry level | Pricing type: Fixed-price

Summary

Looking for someone to train a CNN model that classifies product photos into categories for an e-commerce catalog. Must know Python and PyTorch. A labeled dataset of ~20k images will be provided.

Skills: Python, PyTorch, Computer Vision, CNN
